tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"Can a refund be requested only for items already returned/received back? What happens to items not yet returned?"}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/return", "title": "Items must be returned first", "text": "The shop refunds only units it has received back, as shown by its own return records, never by a statement of the customer or the assistant. If the records show the units arrived, the request continues normally. If they do not, the shop pays nothing for those units; if the customer says the units were already sent, a staff member checks."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/payout", "title": "When the money is paid", "text": "The shop pays a refund only when all of these hold: the order qualifies, the request was on time, the units were received back and not refunded before, the order has one valid payment, the customer confirmed, a staff member approved, and the proposal is still valid. The refund is complete only when the customer has a receipt; until then nothing is reported as refunded."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/window", "title": "Time limit", "text": "A refund must be requested no later than 30 days after the delivery time recorded on the order. Days are exact periods of twenty-four hours, and a request at exactly the deadline is on time. The request time is the moment the shop creates the refund proposal. If an earlier proposal for the same items was created in time but expired or stopped being valid before it was paid, a later request is not refused for being late: a staff member takes the case."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}
